# The OCI CLI, installed by every workflow that reads the estate's vault or its cluster state.
#
# It exists as a file so `actions/setup-python` has something to hash for `cache: pip`. Measured
# 2026-08-29 off /repos/chidionyema/idp/actions/runs/{id}/jobs, never off log prose: 14 install
# sites across 7 workflows, and no pip cache anywhere in .github/workflows. Runs and the seconds
# their oci install steps took: 33217075374 oke-check 33/38/38/43/35/33/35/39, 33215196600
# verify-drill 36, 33215194366 trace-drill 39, 33122872248 vault-seed 39, 33217988021 login-drill
# 71 (that one also fetches a playwright browser), 33204945289 conscience 4 + 40, 33208893050
# estate-escrow 46 -- 569 s of runner time per full sweep spent re-downloading the same wheels.
#
# An earlier count of 12 sites across 5 workflows was measured in the shared checkout, which was
# behind origin/main and hid conscience.yml and estate-escrow.yml. Numbers come from a fresh
# worktree.
#
# Unpinned on purpose: pip still resolves against the index on every run, so a new release is
# picked up the run it lands. What the cache holds is the wheel download, which is the part that
# costs the 40 seconds.
oci-cli
